nomination_rule: Nominate the nonbaseline arm with highest selection-period ensemble Top20 lift over its paired cohort; alphabetical arm tie-break. Shadow-only nomination, no automatic live promotion or evaluation-based tuning.
limitations: Reused historical development dates and unresolved tokenizer pretraining overlap; no untouched prospective claim. Sixfold expansion uses the fixed archived exchange-stratified pool of up to 192 stocks/date, not the whole market. Historical membership and adjustment provenance limitations remain. Five-day labels are embargoed across splits. Fixed four-epoch continuation, not convergence. MPS training can amplify numerical differences; compare matched arms within this run and report all three seeds. Training uses 8-path bag medians versus 64-path reporting, and single-model auxiliary loss versus equal-model ensemble reporting. No loss-weight search or architecture expansion. Extrema scenarios do not establish fills, executed returns or tradable profits.
